human_study.evidence: 112 parsed ImmPort experimental-sample rows are annotated as Homo sapiens.

yf17d_vaccination.evidence: YF17D/yellow-fever terminology is present in the ImmPort experiment metadata.

transcriptomics_available.evidence: 87 transcriptomic experimental samples were identified in the parsed ImmPort manifest.

eif2ak4_measurable.evidence: Transcriptomic predictor data are available and linked to GEO, but EIF2AK4/GCN2 feature coverage has not yet been verified directly from the GEO platform or expression matrix.

quantitative_cd8_response_available.evidence: 25 participant-level quantitative CD8 response measurements with numeric values were found in ImmPort lab_test.txt.

appropriate_timepoints.evidence: Early transcriptomic measurements at days [0, 1, 3, 7] are linked to later quantitative CD8 measurements at days [15].

participant_level_linkage.evidence: All 25 subjects with quantitative CD8 outcomes also have early transcriptomic measurements; overlap=25 subjects.

predictor_data_accessible.evidence: Transcriptomic samples are linked to 87 GEO GSM accessions.

outcome_data_accessible.evidence: 25 numeric CD8 outcome values are directly available in ImmPort lab_test.txt and all map to participant biosamples.

adapter_notes: Evidence was derived from the team's parsed sample_manifest.tsv plus raw ImmPort Tab tables.
Quantitative CD8 outcome accessibility is based on numeric lab_test.txt records linked through biosample.txt.
EIF2AK4/GCN2 measurability remains unresolved until the GEO expression platform or matrix is inspected.
